headline: Marcos Pushes Local Electric-Vehicle Manufacturing, Starting with E-Trikes
seoTitle: Marcos Pushes Local EV Manufacturing | FMB News
seoDescription: President Marcos renewed the government's push for locally manufactured electric vehicles on August 25, starting with Filipino-made electric tricycles.
deck: The President inspected a Caloocan manufacturer as the government works to expand domestic EV production under its existing incentive program.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. renewed the government's push for locally manufactured electric vehicles on Tuesday during a visit to MD Juan Enterprises in Caloocan City.
Current government reporting says the immediate goal is an all-Filipino electric tricycle, with electric jeepneys envisioned as a later step as domestic manufacturing capability expands.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The policy push builds on Executive Order No. 121, which established the Electric Vehicle Incentive Strategy Program with up to ₱60 billion in time-bound, performance-based support for qualified domestic EV and component manufacturing.

The approved newsroom email contained additional claims about a new 10% Philippine-assembled government-fleet mandate and expanded zero-tariff rules. Those details were not independently reproduced in the same-day primary reporting and are not stated here as settled new policy.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Local EV manufacturing could move more of the value chain into the Philippines, from vehicle assembly to batteries and components, while reducing dependence on imported completely built units.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch DTI, BOI and Malacañang for implementing rules, investment commitments, production targets and any formal changes to procurement or tariff policy.
